translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus me Weni Mmwaen Pilate

Nee oatosor moawugowug nge soamwooniir patere me mwaaen kkewe aar ra mwiirh fengaen me sinsein anniug me iir ikkiwe aaemweoi oawuton Council we re pwiungiuw meeta repwene feeori. Ra geoni Jesus nge ra noa fangenoa reen Pilate.
Iwe Pilate a aeiineow pwe, “Een minne aar king re Jews?” Jesus a paniuwaeni pwe, “Een minimwu wo aepesa.”
Soamwooniir patere kkewe ra tipitae wooan Jesus towunepaen aegiaeg,
iwe Pilate a pwan aeiyegiy sefaaeniy pwe, “Wosoapw paniuwaeni? Wo rongorong oanongaen kkepesaen oatuttur kka ra tipi ngaeniug!”
Jesus esa paniuwaeni no, nge Pilate a mwaar noa.
Ra Aettiweginiy Aaen Jesus Mae Noa
Oanongaen raeg reen gupwunon Passover, Pilate egaen saeneti noa erhai rhooan kanepwus, iyo we aeremas re tingoar.
Noan oaton naan nge eno erhai mwaaen noan kanepwus itan Barabbas, eno neeiir aaemweoi rhooa aenneew iwe resooaw nni aeremas faei oaton moawun.
Igiwe aeremas towunap ra rhu fengaen, ra tingoar ngaeni Pilate pwe epwe feeori wunuunun minne a fasiun feoffeeori,
iwe Pilate a aeiineeor pwe, “Oaw mwerhaen pwe ipwe saeneti ngaenigaemi kingaaen Jews een?”
Pilate e giuneei pwe soamwooniir patere kkewe minne re fangenoa Jesus reen pwe epwe noa apwiung faaen itaen aar noanowo ngaeni.
Nge soamwooniir patere kkewe ra aetemaeginiy ngaeniir aeremas kkewe pwe repwe tingoareei Pilate, pwe epwe saeneti ngaeniir Barabbas.
Iwe Pilate a pwan aeiineo sefaaen ngaeniir pwe, “Nge meeta ipwe feeori ngaeni aeremas e oaw faingi pwe kingaaen Jews?”
Ra iyaekkepwas temoag tae, “Kurusuw noa!”
Pilate a pwan aeiineeor pwe, “Meeta taeppen wegitaeg aenneew e a feeori?” Nge iir ra pwan oatomoga aar iyaekkepwas pwe, “Kurusuw noa!”
Pilate e tipaeni pwe epwe amwamwaaiuw nee tipeer aeremas kkewe, iwe a saeneti ngaeniir Barabbas, nge ra wirhiy Jesus nge a fangenoa pwe repwe noa kurusuw noa.
Sonotaw Kkewe ra Aeni Aegekkaei Jesus
Sonotaw kkewe ra paeninoa Jesus noan wororaen iimw we imwaen governor nge ra faingiir to oanongeer sonotaw kkewe rhoaniuwaar.
Ra aememmengaagiu ngaeni erheo mengaag siungiurhoan, nge ra pwan fiti eew mwaer saengi irae towfanfan iwe ra ngaettae wooan rhimwen.
Iwe ra rhaepetae ne aesirowu: “Sirow woamw, Kingaen Jews!”
Ra wirhiy rhimwen ngaeni efoarh irae, nge ra oattuffa, nge ra foatotiw nge ra aesirowu ngaeni.
Igiwe ra moann reen aar aeni aegekkaei, ra pwiniti saengi mengaag siungiurhoan we, nge ra aememmengaagiu ngaeni ikkiwe sipegin mengaagiun. Iwe ra paeninoa pwe repwene noa kurusuw noa.
Ra Kurusuw Noa Jesus

Igiwe re faaeraeg noa wooan aan we, nge ra noa rhuungi erhai mwaaen itan Simon saengi Cyrene, e itto saengi eew soapw pwe epwe toonong noan taeninimw we, nge sonotaw kkewe ra aengimaw ngaeni pwe epwe aiufera kurus we aaen Jesus. (Simon semaen Alexander me Rufus.)
Ra paeninoa Jesus reen eew pwiuneoi itan Golgotha, wewen nge “Nenien Peopeoi Rhimw.”
Igaan iga ra itto aiuniu ngaeni Jesus eew wine e nofit fengaen me aekkaew saefei itan myrrh, nge ese mwerhaen iuniumi.
Ra kurusuw noa Jesus, nge ra inetiy mengaag kkewe wooar, nge re aekkaerh dice wooar ngaere iyo epwe pwigi ifa.
A kiung tiwowu nee oatosor iga re kurusuw noa.
Foatofoaton minne ra tipi ngaeni e iura pwe: “Ieei Kingaen Jews.”
Repwan kurusuw noa riiurhai rhooa mwoarho oaron Jesus, erhai peig mwaaenen, nge erhai peig rhooapwuton.
[Ieei wunuunun pwe epwe pwaenoan miniwe Pwapwior we e Santus e iura pwe, “Refeeori pwe iiy erhai aeremas aenneew.”]
Aeremas kkewe re faaeraeg noa me oaron Jesus re iurhiugi rhimweer nge re aepesa aenneewa Jesus, “Aa! Een miniwe wo iura pwe wopwe fereeitiw Temple we nge wa aiusefaaeniy tae noan enuuw raaen!
Iwe teeotiw me wooan kurus na pwe wopwe aemenewoag!”
Epwan ina rhag wunuunun soamwoonin patere me sinsein anniug kkewe re aeni aegekkaei Jesus reen aar aepesa pwe, “A aemenewaar aaemweoi, nge ese mmwenen aemenewa oanongan!
Oawsa pipiiy Kristus een, iwe Kingaen Israel, aan epwe teeotiw saengi kurusuna igina, ina nge sipwe niugiuniug ngaeni!” Nge pwan rhooa kkewe re tapweei reen kurus repwan aessaewa Jesus.
Maenoan Jesus
Saengi nugunupaen oanowas nge oanongaen faniuw we a rorhappiung noa noan enuuw konook.
Igiwe a enuuw konook nge Jesus a iyaekkepwas temoag tae pwe, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” faan nge, “Aaei Deus, aaei Deus, meeta wa nigitiaei noa reen?”
Aaemweoi aeremas kkewe re iu oaron ra rongorong kkepas kkewe, ra iura pwe, “Oaw rongorong, a faingi Elijah!”

Erhai me neeiir a fattapweto reen faaen eew faerewa, a rhirinong noan wine emwaenn, nge a iseni tae nee soapwon efoarh irae. A aeititae irae we ngaeni ewaen Jesus nge a iura pwe, “Weti sipwe pipiiy aere Elijah epwe itto ateeotiwei me wooan kurus na!”
E apwas temoag noa rhag faaen eew, nge a nurh noa aan ngasangas.
Mengaag we e tteoraeg noan Temple we mwo nge e taeringatiw faaen ruwowu, saengi wooan ittiw faan.
Erhai soamwoonin sonotaw e iu mmwaen kurus we eweri wunuunun aaen Jesus maenoa, a iura pwe, “Ennetaen pwe mwaaen een nge Naiun Deus!”
Aaemweoi rhooapwut reno igiwe, re oawruruto me itaaw. Neeiir rhooapwut kkewe nge Maria Magdalene, Maria we inaen James me Joseph iwe me pwan Salome.
Re tapweei Jesus me noan Galilee reen aar tittipaengi. Towunepeer rhooapwut kkewe re tapweeito Jesus me Jerusalem repwan no igiwe.
Paeyinoan Jesus

A faaeraeg ngaeni nee oatofaaef nge Joseph re Arimathea we a tooto. Iiy erhai e regin oawoai me noan Council we, iwe e wewweti itton minna Mweoiun Deus. A raaenin Aenimowu miniwe (eew raaen mmwaen raaenin Sabbath), noan maemaewaen nee tipaen Joseph a itto reen Pilate a itto tingoar miniwe oanongaen Jesus.
Nge Pilate a riutae igiwe e rongorong pwe Jesus a fasiun maenoa. A tengaeg soamwoonin sonotaw we nge a aeiineow aere a ssiunaei aaen Jesus maenoa.
Mwirin aan rongorong meeta we sonotaw we e iura reen mmwenen Jesus, Pilate a aengaeni Joseph pwe epwe noa pwigi mini oanongaen Jesus.

Joseph meoni erheo mengaag pwerh ffeo, a iseni tiw miniwe oanongan Jesus me wooan kurus we nge a tiugiumi ngaeni mengaag we, a oawnanong noan paeyi we ekken wow me neeiin faai. Iwe a oasoagopeniy to efai faai gin temoag reen aesemaen paeyi we.
Maria Magdalene me Maria we inaen Joseph re pipiiy nge ra giuneei iya re paeiaeni miniwe oanongaen Jesus ee.
